caption: The drawing depicts a brass trivet with an elongated, triangular shape, featuring three short legs. The trivet's surface is mostly open with intricate, ornamental scrollwork, including a central floral motif surrounded by curving vine-like elements. The handle is solid, ending in a circular opening. The trivet is colored in varying shades of brass and gold, with highlights and shadows indicating its metallic texture. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there is a small, handwritten inscription near the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Stand
